beats.say: A razor costs $5. And you keep paying forever.
Buy the handle alone, no blades.
Buy a starter kit with a few blades.
Buy the handle and a subscription of blades.
In year two Gillette sold 90,884 razors. Sounds huge.
But it does a job: lock you into blade purchases.
The handle is a one-time $5 buy.
Every razor sold forces you to buy the cheap, disposable blades - 168 blades in year one alone.
A coffee shop sells a $30 espresso machine, then $2 pods.
A gym offers a $200 treadmill, but $15 monthly class passes. The ongoing option feels smarter.
Watch the cheap entry that hides repeat costs. Follow for more.
